title.zh: 查询API监控数据中对响应时间统计数据

descriptions.zh:
查询指定API的监控信息：Latency(ms)
- 此功能面向开放API的用户
- 监控功能默认对线上环境的API做统计，不包括测试环境的API调用
descriptions.en:
query the latency metrics in milliseconds for a specified API.

- This API is intended for API providers.

- Only statistics for API calls made in the release environment are collected by default.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi describe-api-latency-data --api-id d6f679aeb3be4b91b3688e887ca1fe16 --group-id 63be9002440b4778a61122f14c2b2bbb --start-time 2016-07-23T08:28:48Z --end-time 2016-07-23T09:28:48Z --stage-name RELEASE --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudapi DescribeApiLatencyData --region cn-hangzhou --EndTime '2016-07-23T09:28:48Z' --StageName RELEASE --StartTime '2016-07-23T08:28:48Z' --ApiId d6f679aeb3be4b91b3688e887ca1fe16 --GroupId 63be9002440b4778a61122f14c2b2bbb
